button.label: Get the model
button.name: download_model
button.tool_tip: Downloads the recognition model (about 490 MB) from Hugging Face. Press again to cancel.

combo_box.name: translate_service
combo_box.tool_tip: How sentences are translated. Service: the translation service set in Preferences > Chat (the text goes to it). This PC: with models fetched here (English into Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Russian, Italian, Portuguese; Japanese into English); nothing is sent anywhere.

combo_box.name: translate_to
combo_box.tool_tip: The language sentences are translated into. The first one: the language the chat translation uses (Preferences > Chat).

combo_box.name: dialect
combo_box.tool_tip: Translations into Japanese can be written in a dialect (a game; only the translated text changes, never what was spoken).

button.label: Get translation models
button.name: download_translate_model
button.tool_tip: Downloads the models that translate into the chosen language on this PC (60 to 240 MB each). Press again to cancel. The sources and licenses of the models:

check_box.label: Also write out the parcel's internet radio (when nobody is speaking)
check_box.name: radio
check_box.tool_tip: Listens to the sound of the stream player only, so nothing else is mixed in. It does not connect to the station a second time. Sentences are cut by loudness, and music can give wrong text. Windows 10 version 2004 or later.

spinner.label: Threads
spinner.name: threads
spinner.tool_tip: How many processor threads recognition uses. More is quicker; fewer is lighter. Applies when this window is opened again.

combo_box.name: language
combo_box.tool_tip: The language spoken. Auto finds it out for each sentence (slower, and less exact). Applies when this window is opened again.
